meta.title: Glyph whales
meta.description: Five species of text whales cruise, beat their flukes up and down, and glide behind the conversation.

ui.title: Glyph whales
ui.purpose: Make a sea of text whales your conversation background. Preview it, adjust the scene, then save to apply.
ui.previewSubtitle: See your draft as you adjust the settings below
ui.appearanceDescription: Choose the characters, colors and contrast.
ui.schoolDescription: Set the species, count, size and swimming pace.
ui.readingDescription: Text effects and card glass are independent. Both can be turned off.
ui.seaDescription: Choose wind, clouds, swimming wakes and rain.
ui.unsavedDraft: Unsaved changes, shown in the preview only
ui.savedDraft: Changes preview immediately. Save to apply to the background.
ui.enabledHint: Visible on the conversation page. Stops on other pages.
ui.countHint: 1 to 8 whales with different sizes and depths.
ui.textHint: Repeats these characters to form each whale. Spaces are ignored. Leave blank to use 探索未至之境 (the default phrase, “explore the uncharted”). Up to 40 characters.
ui.speedHint: 0.3 to 2. Default 0.65. Scales cruising, turning and tail beats, with glides between strokes.
ui.opacityHint: 0.04 to 0.9. Default 0.6. Higher values make the body text clearer.
ui.glyphSizeHint: 4 to 16. Default 11. Characters occupy separate, fixed grid cells.
ui.whaleSizeHint: 0.55 to 1.55. Default 1. Changes body length only, not swimming speed; larger whales cover more cells.
ui.colorHint: Choose a shared palette, or give each whale its own stable random color. Applies to glyphs and colored cells.
ui.activityHint: Whales swim more actively while the current session and its subagents work. They slow down and show ! when waiting for a question, approval or plan review. A finished background task shows ✓; a failed one shows ×. Turn off for decoration only.
ui.dictationEchoHint: With the hold-to-talk plugin installed, the school gathers just above the input box while you record, the sea follows your voice, and everyone disperses once the transcript is in. Only active while the master switch is on.
ui.dictationEchoUnavailable: Install dsh-hold-to-dictate (hold-to-talk) to use this. Without it this switch does nothing.
ui.quietCenterHint: Fades whale bodies in the center. The bottom input area always fades out.
ui.leftInsetHint: 0 to 500 pixels. Default 280. Desktop follows the sidebar automatically. In a browser, adjust this to match its width.
ui.readingEffectHint: Choose Off, Glow, Soft blur or Frosted glass around text. Independent of card glass.
ui.glassHint: Frost content cards, the input box and the right sidebar. Independent of text effects. Enabling this turns input-box avoidance off.
ui.glassStrengthHint: 0 to 1. Default 0.55. Higher values make the glass thicker and blurrier, so less of the whale shows through.
ui.composerGlass: Frosted input box (folded into content boxes)
ui.composerGlassHint: The separate 0.10.0 input-box switch; since 0.11.0 it is part of the frosted content boxes. Kept only to read old configs.
ui.composerAvoidHint: Whales treat the input box as an obstacle and swim around it instead of crossing it. Use either this or the frosted content boxes, not both.
ui.spoutHint: On by default. Each whale occasionally lets out a round puff from its blowhole. The puff stays where it started and fades. The whale stays quiet while submerged, and the puff does not become a fountain.
ui.windHint: Sparse aligned surface strokes drift with the breeze, appearing and fading gently. On by default.
ui.cloudsHint: Soft, slow-moving cloud shadows cross the sea and slightly shade whale ink while respecting reading areas. On by default.
ui.rainHint: Fine rain makes small splashes and spreading ripples. Its direction follows the sea breeze. Off by default; turning wind off gradually returns the rain to vertical.
ui.rainIntensityHint: 0 to 1. Default 0.45. Smoothly changes rain density, impacts and ripples. Zero stops the rain; switching rain off keeps this value. Rain ripples are independent of swimming wakes.
ui.pauseOnScrollHint: Off by default: the school keeps swimming while you scroll and the text mask follows the new positions. When on, scrolling hides the decorative layer at once and freezes the simulation; about 140 ms after the last scroll it measures once and fades back in, so a soft mask can never lag behind moving text.
ui.ripplesHint: Swimming and gliding leave an ASCII wake that spreads and fades along the trail. Strong tail strokes add a brief splash. Submerged whales stop making new wakes.
ui.invalid: Enter numbers within the listed ranges. Count, size, and inset must be whole numbers.
ui.conflict: Settings changed elsewhere, or the save was refused. Your edits are preserved. Reload saved values before editing again.
ui.failed: Could not save. Your edits are preserved and can be retried.
ui.speciesHint: Mixed groups cycle through blue, humpback, sperm, fin and bowhead whales. Or choose one species.
ui.renderStyleHint: Glyphs draws letters only. Colored cells add shaded backgrounds inside the whale, with soft glyph-only edges.
ui.fillModeHint: Custom text keeps your original characters. ASCII selects symbols by density and shading. Either works with colored cells.
ui.stylePreview: Live whale preview of the current draft
ui.stylePreviewNote: The preview scales the conversation background uniformly, keeping characters and whales in proportion. Changes appear live; save to apply them. The card at the lower right demonstrates glass and avoidance.
